statement: A review comment about a disclosure-boundary leak can itself be the leak. Explaining what flagged text reveals, or quoting it as harmless, republishes it; so does leaving the earlier commit that carried it in a merged history. Rules: on a public surface, state only which rule was broken and what to change; send the specifics privately to the operator; never quote the flagged text in a public review; merge a branch that once carried leaked text only by squash or from a fresh single-commit branch.
